title: Water Infrastructure EPC Project References – Internal Review Draft
summary: Internal draft gathering supplied water-infrastructure project leads; not a published list of Tongyang completed works.
equipmentScope: Confirm which of these projects involved Tongyang, the contract package, equipment delivered, client permission and project names before any public reference is published.
body:
Internal Project Reference Review — Not for Publication

The following names were supplied for potential consolidation. Their mention does not establish that Tongyang manufactured or supplied equipment for them.

1. Yanzidi Water Plant Renovation / Raw Water Facilities

Original description refers to raw-water pumping at 900,000 m³/day, intake pipelines and BIM deliverables. Project identity and scope have not been independently verified.

2. Dafeng Xintuan River Emergency Raw-Water Source

Proposed 150,000 m³/day reconstruction reference. Verify whether this was a reconstruction project, and confirm the correct Chinese name 新团河.

3. Dafeng Tongyu River Intake and Enhanced Pretreatment

Related intake-upgrade project information exists, but the proposed 100,000 m³/day capacity and biological/conventional/advanced treatment sequence require confirmation.

4. Huayang Underground Wastewater Treatment Plant, Tianfu New Area

18万 m³/day project described as an underground wastewater treatment plant rather than a drinking-water purification or source-water plant. Confirm any Tongyang role before listing as an equipment project.

5. Huaneng Zhengning Mine-Water Deep Treatment and ZLD

Preliminary internal scope lists custom storage tanks and heat exchangers connected with the 2 × 1,000 MW coal power development. Confirm supply contracts, drawings, equipment quantities, project partner disclosure permission and actual Tongyang responsibilities.

Approval Checklist

For each proposed reference: verify the project owner's official name; end-customer and contracting entity; Tongyang purchase order or delivery evidence; equipment quantities and type; photo permissions; whether the project is completed or underway; and precise EPC versus subcontractor scope. Only then move validated examples to the public-facing water EPC project overview.
